artPolicy: Complete character drawings; static expression bodies with independent tail motion; 12 whole-character eating poses repeated three times.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent sprite sheet for a desktop companion. Image 1 is the locked identity reference: SAME clearly adult anime whale woman, mature 5.5-head full-body proportions, warm blue eyes, long indigo hair with pale aqua tips, curved ahoge, lace headband, blue bow, small fin-shaped side locks. Preserve her face and polish of anime cel shading. Change clothing as specified, keep character recognizable. EXACTLY SIX separate COMPLETE head-to-shoes drawings, equal 3 columns x 2 rows, overall square canvas approximately 1536x1536, each cell portrait 2:3. Row-major poses: 1 idle, hands loosely clasped smiling; 2 thinking, one finger at chin; 3 answering, one open palm near chest, friendly speaking mouth; 4 success, eyes happy, one small celebratory fist near shoulder; 5 error, slightly worried face, hands close together; 6 begging, BOTH hands hold an EMPTY shallow silver iron basin in front of waist, hopeful look. All six full characters same scale, face at same height, feet same baseline, vertical body stays straight. A LARGE DARK BLUE WHALE TAIL behind the viewer-left side, entirely outside coat at waist height with a visible narrow curved root connecting behind hip; tail fin stays left of the body, NEVER crosses hands or face. Hair flows towards viewer-right. Tail and hair must stay well inside each cell. Character occupies only 84% cell height and 80% cell width with generous empty transparent gutters on ALL FOUR sides. Entire ahoge, tail and boots in every cell. Truly transparent alpha background, no background color, no checkerboard, no ground or shadows, no decorations, no text, no numbering, no panels. No basin on head, no external hand, no chibi, no bare shoulders, no maid apron over the new clothes.
WINTER OUTFIT: elegant cream-and-powder-blue long quilted puffer coat, clearly visible horizontal puffy stitched segments, powder-blue shoulder yoke and cuffs, fitted waist with simple belt, navy skirt visible below calf-length coat, chunky muted blue knitted scarf with two short ends, warm white tights and matching navy winter ankle boots. A tiny whale zipper charm. Adult feminine winter silhouette, practical and cozy. Keep original lace headband and blue hair bow.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent sprite sheet, second expression set. Image 1 is the LOCKED identity and winter costume sheet; faithfully reproduce its FIRST character, same mature blue-haired whale woman, same adult face, lace headband, curved ahoge, blue side bow, long hair aqua tips, cream/powder-blue long quilted puffer with horizontal puffy stitching, blue knitted scarf, belt, navy skirt peeking below coat, white tights, navy winter boots, whale zipper charm. EXACTLY SIX FULL-BODY drawings in equal 3 columns x 2 rows, square overall canvas around 1536x1536, portrait2:3 cells, generous transparent margins and gutters. ROW-MAJOR six states: 1 picked-up expression: surprised eyes, tiny O mouth, hands lifted near shoulders, body upright; 2 landed expression: eyes relieved, hands loosely out at waist, body upright; 3 sleeping: eyes peacefully shut, hands clasped at waist; 4 enjoying head pats: eyes closed in a content smile, lightly blushing cheeks, hands clasped; 5 pouting: inflated cheeks, lips tiny pout, hands at waist; 6 transition: warm relaxed closed-eye smile, hands gently together. Every image same exact clothing, full head-to-boots scale, ahoge height and shoe baseline. Tail fin visible well to viewer-left at waist height, narrow root behind hip, hair flows to viewer-right; same tail placement as reference, entirely within cell. Keep torso steady and facing camera, no sideways lean or moving whole body. Character occupies at most84%cellheight,80%cellwidth. Real transparent alpha, no checkerboard, no white background, no floor/shadow, no extra characters, no external hand, no rice/hat/basin, no text or numbers.

Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprite sheet. Image 1 is the LOCKED CHARACTER AND WINTER CLOTHING reference. Reproduce that SAME clearly ADULT anime whale woman with mature proportions, same face, blue eyes, long indigo hair with aqua tips, lace headband, curved ahoge, bow and fin side locks. Reproduce EXACT winter outfit on the reference, including all colors, scarf or cape/clasp, boot type, skirt hem, embroidery; no maid apron. EXACTLY SIX SEPARATE COMPLETE HEAD-TO-BOOTS DRAWINGS on an equal 3-column x 2-row grid, square overall canvas approx1536x1536, portrait 2:3cells. Same scale, head position, torso direction and feet baseline in ALL cells. Body stays upright and stable, ONLY expression and arms change. Entire large tail fin stays to viewer-LEFT at waist height, narrow root connected behind hip; long hair flows to viewer-right. Generous empty margins and gutters: character occupies max84%cellheight and80%cellwidth; no tail, hair, ahoge or shoes touching cell boundaries. Real transparent alpha, no background/checkerboard, no floor or shadow, no text,numbers,borders,decorations,external hands,hat,extra people.
FEEDING ANIMATION FIRST HALF, SIX consecutive poses in ROW-MAJOR order. She holds ONE shallow SILVER IRON BASIN full of plain WHITE cooked rice steadily at waist with her LEFT hand on viewer-right. Her RIGHT hand on viewer-left uses ONE small silver spoon. Keep basin position fixed, never spill rice. Pose1 spoon low above basin, expectant smile, eyes open. Pose2 spoon dips INTO rice. Pose3 spoon lifts one visible spoonful out. Pose4 loaded spoon raised to chest height. Pose5 loaded spoon immediately in front of mouth, mouth opening. Pose6 spoon reaches open mouth and she takes the bite. Keep same outfit and full silhouette/feet/head stable. No chopsticks, no second basin, no hat.

Use case: identity-preserve. SECOND HALF of a production feeding animation. Image 1 is the EXACT LOCKED FEEDING CHARACTER reference: SAME clearly adult blue-haired anime whale woman, same face and mature proportions, SAME cream-and-powder-blue long quilted puffer coat and belt, blue knitted scarf, navy skirt hem, white tights and navy winter boots, lace headband, curved ahoge, long aqua-tipped hair, whale tail behind viewer-left. EXACTLY SIX COMPLETE head-to-shoes drawings in equal 3 columns x 2 rows, square overall sheet approx1536x1536 with portrait2:3cells. Follow the LAST pose of reference (spoon at mouth), row-major poses: 1 spoon withdrawing just below lips, mouth closed after taking rice, open eyes; 2 small cheeks chewing, spoon lowered to chin level; 3 chewing with gently closed smiling eyes, spoon lowered to chest; 4 satisfied soft smile, eyes half open, spoon still at chest; 5 spoon lowers close to the rice surface, eyes open; 6 ready for the next bite, spoon low above the basin, expectant gentle smile. EXACTLY ONE SILVER IRON BASIN of plain white cooked rice stays at WAIST in her LEFT hand on viewer-right. ONE silver spoon in her RIGHT hand on viewer-left. Keep identical basin and hand direction, consistent bowl position, no chopsticks/extra basin. Keep body straight, head and feet stable, clothing consistent. Entire tail fin at waist height to viewer-left and flowing hair to viewer-right fit WELL INSIDE cells. Character occupies max84%cellheight and80%cellwidth, generous transparent gutters and top/bottom padding, entire ahoge and boots uncut. True transparent alpha background, no checkerboard/white background, no floor shadow, no text/numbers/panels, no hat or external hand.
